channel.title: Camelot Flows Blog
channel.description: Honest, practical field notes on getting found online, owning your website, speed and conversion, and AI automation for small businesses. Written by Camelot Flows.

item.title: Why Your WordPress Site Feels Slow on Your Phone
item.description: The three things that quietly slow almost every WordPress site on a phone, the one number that tells the truth, and how to check yours tonight.

item.title: How to Leave Your Web Agency Without Losing Your Site
item.description: The exact order to secure your domain, backup, hosting and email before you tell your web agency you are leaving, so you never lose your website.

item.title: How ChatGPT Decides Which Local Businesses to Recommend
item.description: There is no secret AI SEO trick. ChatGPT names the businesses it can read clearly. Here is what it actually reads and what it ignores.

item.title: Why Is My New Website Not Showing Up on Google?
item.description: Two different reasons a new site is missing from Google, and a fifteen minute check to tell which problem you actually have.

item.title: Do You Actually Own Your Website? A 5-Minute Check
item.description: Five accounts decide whether you own your website or just rent it from your agency. Here is the 5-minute checklist I run before taking over any site.

item.title: The Import Back-Office Tax: 5 Jobs to Automate Before You Hire
item.description: An import back office runs on manual follow-ups, EUR.1 paperwork, and copy-paste order entry. Here are five of those jobs you can hand to a system — before you hire another person.

item.title: What an AI Intake Assistant Actually Does for a Small Service Business
item.description: An AI assistant on a small-business site is not a chatbot gimmick. Here is what one actually does on a real garage-door repair site — a 24/7 intake worker that catches the after-hours leads a small team cannot answer in person.

item.title: Building Dreamscape in Parallel: How Game Dev Is Sharpening My Skills
item.description: Building a narrative RPG in Ren'Py while doing client web work full-time sounds like a contradiction. It isn't. Here is how game dev sharpens the exact muscles that make better web projects.

item.title: How I Build Sites for Clients: Simple WordPress, Custom Builds, and AI Automations
item.description: Not every project needs AI, a custom build, or a complex CRM integration. Here is how I decide what stack to use for each client — and where AI automations actually change the equation.

item.title: What You Get for €390: Landing Page or Portfolio Site, Both With AI
item.description: Every 390 euro project includes either a landing page with smart AI chatbot, or a full 5-10 page portfolio site with chatbot and auto-blog. Fixed scope, fast launch, AI included.
